global_philosophy: Bloomberg Terminal but beautiful. A multi-tenant, bank-grade agentic AI platform for independent RIAs. Focus is on data density, absolute clarity, and high-contrast minimal components. Zero unnecessary decoration. Every pixel is accountable.

headings.rationale: Authoritative, premium, Swiss-inspired. Breaks away from standard SaaS tech looks.

body.rationale: High legibility for dense UI grids, neutral but crisp.

mono.rationale: Essential for 'financial terminal' aesthetics. Used for all numbers, KPIs, timestamps, and agent thought streams.

VETOED.special: Signal Red for hard compliance veto by SentinelCompliance.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Control Room Grid (Mode B). Extreme density but high legibility.

shell.left_nav: w-64 border-r border-white/10 h-screen fixed flex flex-col justify-between p-4
shell.main_workspace: ml-64 mr-80 min-h-screen pt-16 px-8 pb-12
shell.intelligence_rail: w-80 border-l border-white/10 h-screen fixed right-0 bg-[#0A0A0A] p-4 overflow-y-auto
shell.header: h-16 border-b border-white/10 fixed top-0 ml-64 right-0 w-[calc(100%-16rem)] bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-md z-40 flex items-center justify-between px-8

components.cards: rounded-sm border border-white/10 bg-[#141414] p-4 lg:p-6 shadow-none
components.radius: max rounded-sm (2px) to maintain the terminal sharpness.

icons_and_assets.rationale: High-end, technical duotone weight perfect for dashboards.

images.description: Abstract metallic neural network squares for the tenant login or empty states.

elements.name: KPI Strip
elements.style: 4-col grid, mono numbers, subtle trend indicators (green/red).

elements.name: Recent Council Sessions
elements.style: Dense data table, mono timestamps, state badges.

elements.name: Scenario Inputs
elements.style: Slider + Number inputs with IBM Plex Mono values.

elements.name: Planning Prompt
elements.style: Large text area with terminal-like placeholder.

elements.name: Agent Vote Grid
elements.style: Bento grid of 14 agents. RUNNING agents use 'Tracing Beam' border animation. VETOED turns the card red.

elements.name: Real-time Thought Stream
elements.style: Terminal-style scrolling log in IBM Plex Mono. Each line prefixed with timestamp and Agent Name.

elements.name: Consensus Header
elements.style: Sticky top block. Displays confidence score in large mono typography.

elements.name: Trace Timeline
elements.style: Vertical timeline. Steps: THOUGHT, ACTION, OBSERVATION, RESPONSE.

elements.name: Filters
elements.style: Dense top bar for regulator-grade filtering.

elements.name: Provider Cards
elements.style: Flat design, logos, and glowing sync status dots.

interactions_and_motion.live_streaming: New text lines fade in and slide up slightly. Monospace typewriter effect for agent output.
interactions_and_motion.running_state: Elements in RUNNING state must have an active pulse or 'Tracing Beam' mask animation on the border.
interactions_and_motion.hover: Hovering a row or card gently lightens the border to white/30 and bg to #1A1A1A. No physical lift (keep it flat).

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color hex codes and Tailwind opacity values defined in the states section.
Do NOT use standard rounded cards. Override Shadcn to use rounded-sm or rounded-none.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings, Manrope for Body, and IBM Plex Mono for all data/numbers.
Implement the Layout Shell exactly as defined: Fixed left nav, center workspace, fixed right rail.
Ensure 'Live Council Session' agent thought streams look like an authentic financial/terminal log.
Install required fonts from Google Fonts or local fontsource.
Never use generic placeholder text; populate with domain-specific RIA financial data.
